about_the_game:
You are a powerful being who wields a forbidden force known as Indulge.

With this mesmerizing ability, you delve deep into the hearts of women, uncovering hidden fragments of their minds. As each puzzle is completed, they become drawn to you—unable to resist the pull, they willingly surrender to your will.

Armed with this seductive power, you set out to enchant and conquer one captivating woman after another.

Gameplay unfolds through addictive, high-tension, Tetris-style puzzle challenges.

Clear lines to earn rewards and unlock new stages by reaching target scores.

And the reward?
Provocative artwork and a rich, immersive story. As you advance, the scenes grow bolder, revealing the secret desires of these fascinating characters.

Features:

  • A tale of irresistible temptation told through 240 illustrations and 10 unique characters, each with her own charm

  • 400 thrilling, Tetris-inspired levels packed with puzzles and surprises

  • Gallery mode for your personal happy time

content_descriptors.notes: "This game contains sexual themes, nudity, and depictions of sexual acts. Some scenes may include sexual dialogue and visual representations of sexual activity. Additionally, the game may feature adult humor and sensitive topics."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 710 / AMD Radeon HD 8570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB MB available space
